cards.title: Eleventy
cards.description: A simpler static site generator. Transforms templates into fast, static HTML with zero client-side JavaScript by default.

cards.title: Liquid
cards.description: An open-source template language created by Shopify. Used for rendering dynamic content in Eleventy templates.

cards.title: Alpine.js
cards.description: A rugged, minimal framework for composing JavaScript behavior in your markup.

cards.title: Lucide Icons
cards.description: A community-run fork of Feather Icons, providing crisp SVG icons throughout the interface.

cards.title: esbuild
cards.description: An extremely fast JavaScript bundler and minifier. Bundles the frontend JavaScript and minifies CSS for production.

cards.title: PostCSS
cards.description: A tool for transforming CSS with JavaScript plugins. Used with postcss-import to process a modular CSS architecture.

cards.title: Prettier
cards.description: An opinionated code formatter. Ensures consistent code style across all source files.

cards.title: TypeScript
cards.description: A typed superset of JavaScript that compiles to plain JavaScript. Used for build configuration and type checking.
